No patches. Out-of-scope observations (not applied): (1) 21.4. Bestiary/Mutations.md row 3 has '**Spiked Carapac**e' -- mirrors the p204 font data exactly, but the page image likely prints the whole word bold; worth an image check in the table pass. (2) 26.4. Simple Traps_.md embeds 26.4.14-26.4.24 in alphabetical order, while p228 prints Magic, Poison, Monster, Pit, Needle (the Poison intro paragraph prints before the Magic table); a reorder needs multi-line moves, outside single-line patch rules. (3) Simple Traps list prints '**1. Danger** level' (numeral inside the bold); the note keeps a markdown numbered list '1. **Danger** level' per the numbered-steps convention.
